_doc: PH-03 card deck. 'effect' is a key under cards.* in /shared/balance.json, so all cash amounts live there. Every physical card has an opt-out (optOut text); opting out of a physical card costs nothing.

cards.title: Getaway Monologue
cards.text: Deliver a 10-second villain monologue about the vault you're about to crack.

cards.title: Inside Voice
cards.text: Whisper everything you say until the next round starts. The crew judges.

cards.title: Alibi
cards.text: Give the crew a ridiculous, detailed alibi for where you were last night. 15 seconds.

cards.title: Mugshot
cards.text: Strike your best mugshot pose and hold it for 5 seconds without laughing.

cards.title: Vault Squats
cards.text: Do 10 squats while counting out loud in a heist-movie accent.
cards.optOut: Physical limits? Opt out free, no questions asked.

cards.title: Laser Limbo
cards.text: Stand up and dodge imaginary lasers in slow motion for 10 seconds.
cards.optOut: Physical limits? Opt out free, no questions asked.

cards.title: Getaway Run
cards.text: Run in place for 15 seconds, narrating the police chase.
cards.optOut: Physical limits? Opt out free, no questions asked.

cards.title: Safe Hands
cards.text: Balance a key on the back of your hand for 10 seconds.
cards.optOut: Physical limits? Opt out free, no questions asked.

cards.title: Double or Nothing
cards.text: Name 5 famous heist movies in 15 seconds. Crew votes on whether you made it.

cards.title: Poker Face
cards.text: Hold a straight face for 15 seconds while the crew tries to make you laugh (no touching).

cards.title: Memory Palace
cards.text: Recite every player's name and animal, in seating order.
